title: Benchmarking Large Language Models Under Data Contamination: A Survey from Static to Dynamic Evaluation
authors_zh: Simin Chen，Yiming Chen，Zexin Li，Yifan Jiang，Zhongwei Wan，Yixin He，Dezhi Ran，Tianle Gu，Haizhou Li，Tao Xie，Baishakhi Ray。
paper_type_zh: 数据污染下 LLM 基准的 survey 与评测框架
best_for_zh: 构建、选择或审计抗污染 LLM benchmark 的研究者。
one_line: This survey and living repository map static and dynamic defenses against benchmark contamination.
系统梳理污染下静态与动态 LLM 基准，并提出动态基准的六项审计准则。
why: It supplies an audit taxonomy and a maintained artifact index for deciding whether an evaluation can still be trusted.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 addition: its central contribution audits contamination, verifier reliability, or judge bias with an explicit evaluation object.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Public static benchmarks are vulnerable to training-data exposure, but dynamic replacements lack a shared way to judge whether their regenerated tests remain correct, novel, comparable, and interpretable.

This survey organizes static mitigations and dynamic benchmark construction, reviews how dynamic benchmarks evaluate themselves, and proposes a unified quality framework. It releases a continuing GitHub collection rather than a new benchmark dataset.

公开静态基准容易在训练中暴露，但动态替代方案又缺少共同标准来判断再生成测试是否仍正确、新颖、可比较且可解释。若只因“更新了数据”便相信结果，污染风险可能被另一类生成或验证风险替代。

本文系统组织静态缓解与动态构造方法，审计动态基准如何自评，并提出统一质量框架。它维护持续更新的 GitHub 收集库，而非发布新的 benchmark 数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper reframes contamination-resistant evaluation as a transformation of a static dataset over time. It reviews more than 50 dynamic-benchmark papers, groups mechanisms into temporal cutoff, rule-based, LLM-based and hybrid generation, and rates them with correctness, scalability, collision, complexity stability, diversity and interpretability. The official repository collects methods; it is not a released training/evaluation corpus.
论文将抗污染评测表述为静态数据集随时间被转换的过程。作者审阅 50 余篇动态基准论文，将机制归为时间截断、规则生成、LLM 生成与混合生成，并以正确性、可扩展性、碰撞、复杂度稳定性、多样性、可解释性六项准则审计。官方仓库只持续收集方法，不是已发布的训练或评测语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define static data as prompts, answers and a scorer; define dynamic data as a time-indexed transformation of that seed, or creation from an empty seed.
  2. Review over 50 papers and classify each construction mechanism.
  3. Map each benchmark to six criteria; mark support, partial support, or absence, with validation determining whether LLM-generated data supports correctness.
  4. Use the resulting matrix to identify design gaps. Criterion formulas and classifications are author abstractions; a practitioner must fix the task oracle, update policy, and release log before deployment.

1. 将静态数据定义为提示、答案和评分器；动态数据则是该种子在时间上的转换，或从空种子创建。
  2. 审阅 50 余篇论文，按构造机制分类。
  3. 将每个基准映射到六项准则，记为支持、部分支持或缺失；对 LLM 生成数据，是否有验证决定正确性是否可支持。
  4. 用矩阵定位设计缺口。公式与分类是作者抽象；部署前须固定任务 oracle、更新政策和发布日志。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
• The primary source reports its own controlled comparisons and task coverage.
  • Evidence boundary: this Card does not transfer the reported metric beyond the source’s models, benchmarks, or access assumptions.
  • Reuse check: reproduce the official protocol before interpreting a gain as clean generalization.

以下为中文维护摘要，术语以原文和官方 artifact 为准。 - The primary source reports its own controlled comparisons and task coverage. - Evidence boundary: this Card does not transfer the reported metric beyond the source’s models, benchmarks, or access assumptions. - Reuse check: reproduce the official protocol before interpreting a gain as clean generalization.

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work proposes individual detectors or living benchmarks. This survey instead evaluates the benchmark-construction process itself, adding collision and complexity stability to familiar quality concerns. The mechanisms are not new; the contribution is a common audit vocabulary across them.
既有工作多提出单一检测器或单个“活”基准。本文转而审计基准构造过程本身，将碰撞与复杂度稳定性加入常见质量关切。构造机制并不新；真正贡献是为不同机制提供共同的审计词汇和比较坐标。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Fast-moving methods may be missing from the survey.
  2. The six criteria are a first proposal and need refinement and real-world validation.
  3. The review stays high-level, limiting implementation guidance. Curators should therefore not infer a benchmark’s safety merely from its category; inspect its update log, oracle, and generated-item validation.

1. 领域变化快，survey 可能遗漏近期方法。
  2. 六项准则只是初步提案，仍需真实场景的修订与验证。
  3. 综述保持高层，实施细节有限。编者风险是不能只由类别推断某基准安全；应检查更新日志、oracle 和生成条目的验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the six criteria as a release checklist: state seed and transformation, measure regeneration overlap, verify answers with an oracle, report complexity drift and costs, and publish transformation traces. The output is an auditable benchmark report. Do not use it as proof of contamination absence without model-specific exposure testing.
可将六项准则作为发布清单：说明种子和转换，测量再生成重叠，用 oracle 验证答案，报告复杂度漂移与成本，并公开转换轨迹，输出可审计的 benchmark report。若未做模型特定暴露测试，不能把该框架当作“没有污染”的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Dynamic evaluation transforms or creates test data over time.
  2. Audit six properties, especially collision and complexity drift.
  3. The GitHub repository is a collection, not a dataset release.
  4. Evidence: review of 50+ papers and the Table 2 matrix.
  5. Require an oracle and update trace before calling a benchmark contamination-resistant.

1. 定位：动态评测会随时间转换或创建测试数据。
  2. 抓手：审计六项属性，尤其是碰撞和复杂度漂移。
  3. Artifact：GitHub 是方法收集库，不是数据集发布。
  4. 证据：审阅 50 余篇论文及表 2 矩阵。
  5. 决定：未提供 oracle 与更新轨迹前，不应称其抗污染。
